lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag tila(n)g mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Raag Tilang, First Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਯਕ ਅਰਜ ਗੁਫਤਮ ਪੇਸਿ ਤੋ ਦਰ ਗੋਸ ਕੁਨ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: yak araj guphatam pes to dar gos kun karataar ||
lines.translation: I offer this one prayer to You; please listen to it, O Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਕਾ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਰੀਮ ਤੂ ਬੇਐਬ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hakaa kabeer kareem too beaib paravadagaar ||1||
lines.translation: You are true, great, merciful and spotless, O Cherisher Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਮੁਕਾਮੇ ਫਾਨੀ ਤਹਕੀਕ ਦਿਲ ਦਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: duneeaa mukaame phaanee tahakeek dil daanee ||
lines.translation: The world is a transitory place of mortality - know this for certain in your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਮ ਸਰ ਮੂਇ ਅਜਰਾਈਲ ਗਿਰਫਤਹ ਦਿਲ ਹੇਚਿ ਨ ਦਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mam sar mooi ajaraaeel giraphatah dil hech na daanee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death, has caught me by the hair on my head, and yet, I do not know it at all in my mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਪਿਸਰ ਪਦਰ ਬਿਰਾਦਰਾਂ ਕਸ ਨੇਸ ਦਸਤੰਗੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan pisar padar biraadaraa(n) kas nes dasata(n)geer ||
lines.translation: Spouse, children, parents and siblings - none of them will be there to hold your hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਖਿਰ ਬਿਅਫਤਮ ਕਸ ਨ ਦਾਰਦ ਚੂੰ ਸਵਦ ਤਕਬੀਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aakhir biaphatam kas na daarad choo(n) savad takabeer ||2||
lines.translation: And when at last I fall, and the time of my last prayer has come, there shall be no one to rescue me. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬ ਰੋਜ ਗਸਤਮ ਦਰ ਹਵਾ ਕਰਦੇਮ ਬਦੀ ਖਿਆਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: sab roj gasatam dar havaa karadem badee khiaal ||
lines.translation: Night and day, I wandered around in greed, contemplating evil schemes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਹੇ ਨ ਨੇਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਮ ਮਮ ਈਁ ਚਿਨੀ ਅਹਵਾਲ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gaahe na nekee kaar karadam mam ee(n) chinee ahavaal ||3||
lines.translation: I never did good deeds; this is my condition. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਦਬਖਤ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਬਖੀਲ ਗਾਫਿਲ ਬੇਨਜਰ ਬੇਬਾਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: badabakhat ham ch bakheel gaaphil benajar bebaak ||
lines.translation: I am unfortunate, miserly, negligent, shameless and without the Fear of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੁਗੋਯਦ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਰਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਾਕਰਾਂ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bugoyad jan turaa tere chaakaraa(n) paa khaak ||4||1||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I am Your humble servant, the dust of the feet of Your slaves. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 1 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Tilang, First Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਂਗ ਖਲੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhau teraa bhaa(n)g khalaRee meraa cheet ||
lines.translation: The Fear of You, O Lord God, is my marijuana; my consciousness is the pouch which holds it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਅਤੀਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai devaanaa bhaiaa ateet ||
lines.translation: I have become an intoxicated hermit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਕਾਸਾ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kaasaa darasan kee bhookh ||
lines.translation: My hands are my begging bowl; I am so hungry for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਦਰਿ ਮਾਗਉ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mai dar maagau neetaa neet ||1||
lines.translation: I beg at Your Door, day after day. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਉ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tau darasan kee karau samaai ||
lines.translation: I long for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਦਰਿ ਮਾਗਤੁ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai dar maagat bheekhiaa paai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am a beggar at Your Door - please bless me with Your charity. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਸਰਿ ਕੁਸਮ ਮਿਰਗਮੈ ਹਰਣਾ ਸਰਬ ਸਰੀਰੀ ਚੜੑਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kesar kusam miragamai haranaa sarab sareeree chaRhnaa ||
lines.translation: Saffron, flowers, musk oil and gold embellish the bodies of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਭਗਤਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਇਨੇਹੀ ਸਰਬੇ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)dan bhagataa jot inehee sarabe paramal karanaa ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord's devotees are like sandalwood, which imparts its fragrance to everyone. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਿਅ ਪਟ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghi pat bhaa(n)daa kahai na koi ||
lines.translation: No one says that ghee or silk are polluted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਵਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa bhagat varan mahi hoi ||
lines.translation: Such is the Lord's devotee, no matter what his social status is.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵੇ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: terai naam nive rahe liv laai ||
lines.translation: Those who bow in reverence to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, remain absorbed in Your Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥੧॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tin dar bheekhiaa paai ||3||1||2||
lines.translation: Nanak begs for charity at their door. ||3||1||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 1 ghar 3 ||
lines.translation: Tilang, First Mehl, Third House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਹਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਲੀਤੜਾ ਲਬਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu tan maaiaa paahiaa piaare leetaRaa lab ra(n)gaae ||
lines.translation: This body fabric is conditioned by Maya, O beloved; this cloth is dyed in greed.
